title: Disclaimer
summary: What CampusEduX does and does not promise.
intro: This Disclaimer explains the limits of what {{appName}} provides. It forms part of the Terms & Conditions. Nothing in {{appName}} is professional, legal, financial or career advice.
The Service and its content are provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind to the fullest extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: 1. Education and academic outcomes
body: Notes, projects, practice material and guidance in {{appName}} are learning aids. {{appName}} does not guarantee any marks, grades, exam results, project approval or academic outcome. You are responsible for meeting your institution's requirements and academic-integrity rules.

sections.heading: 2. Jobs and employment
body: Job listings are provided for information, may originate from third parties, and can be inaccurate, changed or removed at any time. {{appName}} is not an employer, recruiter or placement agency and is not a party to any hiring process. Using the Service does not guarantee any job, interview, response or offer.

sections.heading: 3. Placement preparation
body: Aptitude, DSA, HR, company-wise material, mock tests and analytics are practice tools. Scores and performance analysis are indicative only and do not predict or guarantee selection, placement or a specific company's outcome.

sections.heading: 4. Resume builder and ATS scores
body: Resume templates, suggestions and ATS scores are automated estimates generated from your input. They are not reviewed by a recruiter, do not reflect any specific employer's system, and do not guarantee shortlisting or hiring.

sections.heading: 5. Projects
body: Projects are provided for educational and development purposes under the Project License Policy. {{appName}} does not warrant that a project is fit for a particular purpose, free of defects, secure, production-ready or compliant with any standard unless expressly stated for a Custom Project. Test and review any project before relying on it.

sections.heading: 6. Third-party information and links

sections.heading: 7. Service availability

sections.heading: 8. No professional advice

sections.heading: 9. Limitation of liability
body: Your use of the Service is at your own risk.
